scripts.check: lefthook run check && npm run check:type && npm run check:version && npm run check:alloc
scripts.check:package: npm run build && publint --strict && attw --pack . --profile esm-only
scripts.check:type: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.build-plugin.json --noEmit && tsc -p examples/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p benchmarks/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.examples: npm run build && tsx examples/basics.ts && tsx examples/iteration.ts && tsx examples/component-sets.ts && tsx examples/relationships.ts && tsx examples/resources.ts && tsx examples/game-loop.ts && tsx examples/optionals.ts
scripts.lint:go: tsx scripts/trim-go-cache.ts && go -C optimizer tool golangci-lint run ./... && go -C optimizer tool golangci-lint run -c .golangci.tests.yml ./...
scripts.fix: lefthook run check --command lint --command md --command gofmt --command fmt && fallow fix --yes --no-create-config
scripts.test: npm run test:vitest && npm run test:go
scripts.test:go: node -e "require('node:fs').mkdirSync('coverage', { recursive: true })" && tsx scripts/trim-go-cache.ts && go -C optimizer test -race ./... -coverprofile=../coverage/go.out && tsx scripts/check-go-coverage.ts coverage/go.out
scripts.version: tsx scripts/sync-version.ts && git add src/version.ts optimizer/internal/version/version.go
